mechanism: Amphotericin B causes hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia, which increase the risk of cardiac arrhythmias when combined with albuterol's beta-2 agonist effects that can also cause electrolyte shifts and cardiac stimulation.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (potassium and magnesium) regularly; consider potassium and magnesium supplementation during concurrent use; monitor for cardiac arrhythmias and tremor.
